curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What will follow when a social worker’s visit unleashes a cycle of terror?
curatedMovie.description: After visiting an elderly woman at the site of a notorious murder case, a social worker unleashes a cycle of terror that transmits through its victims.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful supernatural dread with steady pacing, best experienced alone with full attention.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This Japanese horror story follows a social worker’s visit as it releases a cycle of terror tied to a notorious murder case.
